blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Personal AI agents are increasingly capable of handling long-horizon tasks across applications, yet users often need to invest substantial effort in specifying goals, resolving ambiguity, and verifying outcomes. We argue that progress should be measured by how effectively agents amplify human agency: enabling people to pursue their goals with less routine supervision while retaining control over consequential decisions. We advocate Avatar Intelligence, a paradigm of persistent personal agents that represent users' goals, values, and constraints through sustained decision delegation across contexts and time. We describe a maturity roadmap from human-directed execution to autonomous operation within delegated domains, and introduce the Agentic Oversight Index (AOI) as a framework for evaluating delivered value against agent-side operational cost and human oversight burden. We identify three core research challenges: identity-continuous personalization that carries user preferences across tasks, user-situated evolution through Rehearsal Engineering, and safety mechanisms that combine technical control with accountability and recourse. These directions define a research agenda for reliable decision delegation to personal agents across tasks and over time.
blocks.zh: 个人AI代理越来越有能力处理跨应用程序的长视野任务,然而用户往往需要投入大量精力来明确目标,解决歧义并核实结果. 我们主张,衡量进展的尺度应当是代理人如何有效地扩大人类机构:使人民能够在较少例行监督的情况下实现其目标,同时保留对相应决定的控制。 我们主张通过在各种背景和时间上持续下放决策权,使《阿凡达情报》成为代表用户目标、价值观和制约因素的持久个人代理人的模式。 我们描述了从人力指导执行到授权范围内自主运作的成熟路线图,并采用了代理监督指数,作为对照代理方业务费用和人员监督负担评价交付价值的框架。 我们确定了三个核心研究挑战:身份持续个性化,它包含着用户对各种任务的偏好;通过再排练工程的用户定位演变;以及技术控制与问责和追索相结合的安全机制。 这些指示确定了一项研究议程,以便把可靠的决策权下放给不同任务和不同时期的个人代理人。

blocks.en: Imagine an AI agent system that acts on your behalf: it makes decisions, executes actions, and communicates with humans or other agents with minimal human intervention. Such a system is more than a tool that waits for explicit commands; it resembles a user-centric operating system—a persistent digital representative that embodies your preferences, values, and goals and operates continuously across contexts and time.
blocks.zh: 想象一个代表您行事的AI代理系统:它做决定,执行行动,并在人类极少干预的情况下与人类或其他代理通信. 这种系统不仅仅是一个等待明确命令的工具;它类似于一个以用户为中心的操作系统——一个持续的数字代表,它体现了你的喜好、价值观和目标,并持续地在各种背景和时间中运作。

blocks.en:
Recent years have witnessed the rapid development of foundation models (e.g., GPT-5.5 [ 1 ] , Gemini-3 [ 2 ] , and DeepSeek-V4 [ 3 ] ), which establish a general-purpose backbone for autonomous agents such as MUSE 1 1 1 https://ai.meta.com/muse/ . and dots 2 2 2 https://openai.com/index/introducing-dots/ . .
Meanwhile, agent frameworks (e.g., those equipped with prompt/context/harness engineering and memory systems) have enabled more robust long-horizon task capabilities [ 4 ] . Beyond the exchange of information in digital environments, agents can increasingly manipulate end-user devices such as computers and smartphones [ 5 ] .

同时,代理框架(例如,配备了即时/背景/硬件工程和存储系统的代理框架)使长期任务能力更加强大[4]。 除了数字环境下的信息交流外,代理商还可以越来越多地操纵终端用户设备,如计算机和智能手机[5].

blocks.en:
These developments make persistent personal agents increasingly plausible, but leave a central question unresolved: how much work must users still do to make delegation effective?
When delegating a research task, for example, an agent may retrieve and summarize documents while the user continues to resolve ambiguous objectives, correct interpretations, and judge whether the result is sufficient.
Execution effort decreases, while the burden of specification, coordination, and verification remains substantial.
blocks.zh:
这些事态发展使持续的个人代理人越来越可信,但有一个核心问题仍未解决:用户必须做多少工作才能有效下放权力?
例如,在授权一项研究任务时,代理人可以检索和总结文件,而用户则继续解决模棱两可的目标,纠正解释并判断结果是否足够。
执行努力减少,而规格、协调和核查的负担仍然很大。

blocks.en:
Our position is that personal agents should amplify human agency by allowing users to pursue more of their goals without supervising every intermediate decision.
Human agency includes the ability to set and revise goals, choose which decisions to delegate, and redirect action when circumstances change.
Progress in personal agents therefore depends on reducing the effort required to obtain reliable, user-aligned outcomes while preserving these forms of control.
blocks.zh:
我们的立场是,个人代理人应该扩大人类机构,允许用户追求更多的目标,而不监督每一个中间决定。
人类机构包括制定和修订目标的能力,选择授权的决定,以及在情况发生变化时调整行动方向。
因此,个人代理人员的进展取决于减少在保持这些控制形式的同时取得可靠、用户一致的结果所需的努力。

blocks.en:
We use Avatar Intelligence to describe persistent personal agents that represent a user’s goals, values, and constraints across tasks and over time.
Concretely, an avatar should maintain commitments while the user is unavailable, adapt to changing circumstances, and know when to seek clarification or additional authorization.
This requires learning from ongoing interactions and evaluating how reliably the agent represents the user over time.
blocks.zh:
我们用Avatar Intelligence来描述代表用户目标、价值和各种任务和时间的限制的顽固的个人代理人。
具体地说,在用户无法使用的情况下,一个假象应保持承诺,适应不断变化的情况,并知道何时寻求澄清或额外授权。
这需要学习正在进行的互动,并评估代理人在一段时间内代表用户的可靠性。

blocks.en: We develop this position through four contributions: • We characterize Avatar Intelligence through persistent user representation and sustained decision delegation, and describe a user-centric system architecture that supports these functions. • We outline a maturity roadmap (L0–L3) for transferring operational and decision responsibilities within defined delegation scopes. • We introduce the Agentic Oversight Index (AOI), an evaluation framework that accounts for delivered value, agent-side operational cost, and human oversight burden. • We identify three core research directions: identity-continuous personalization, user-situated evolution through rehearsal, and safety mechanisms for controlled and accountable delegation.

blocks.en: 2  Avatar Intelligence
blocks.zh: 2. 神通情报

blocks.en:
The essence of Avatar Intelligence is to align AI agents with human needs and expectations.
At its core, Avatar Intelligence reshapes the AI–human relationship by transforming agents from passive instruments into autonomous digital representatives that embody user identity, preferences, and values.
Rather than merely automating isolated tasks, avatars extend human agency beyond biological constraints by enabling persistent, autonomous operation across contexts and time.
blocks.zh:
Avatar Intelligence的本质是使AI特工符合人类需要和期望.
Avatar Intelligence通过将代理从被动的仪器转变为体现用户身份、喜好和价值观的自主数字代表,重新塑造了AI-人际关系。
异想天开的人不仅使孤立的任务自动化,而且还使人类的力量超越了生物的局限,能够持续、自主地在各种背景和时间之间运作。

blocks.en: 2.1  Avatar as a User-Centric System
blocks.zh: 2.1 阿凡达作为用户-儿童系统

blocks.en: Figure 2: Avatar Intelligence as a user-centric operating system. A persistent user model and memory support the inner loop of perception, planning, decision, and execution. The outer ring identifies three system capabilities: work continuity, proactive service, and capability expansion. Work, assistant, social, and custom clones carry the shared user identity into distinct task contexts, connecting the avatar to tools, applications, and other agents.
blocks.zh: 图2:"神通情报"作为以用户为中心的操作系统. 一个持续的用户模式和内存支持感知,规划,决定和执行的内环. 外环确定三种系统能力:工作连续性、主动服务以及能力扩展。 工作,助手,社会和自定义克隆将共享的用户身份带入不同的任务背景,将外观与工具,应用程序等代理连接.

blocks.en:
We conceptualize Avatar Intelligence as a user-centric operating system that externalizes a user's cognition into a persistent and executable digital form (Figure 2 ). The kernel of such a system is not a thin memory cache, but a faithful and continuously updated model of the user's cognitive identity.
More specifically, at the OS level, the Avatar continuously observes the user’s behavioral patterns and decision-making logic, implicitly modeling and iteratively refining its understanding of the user’s profile and behavioral patterns. Based on this evolving user model, it can automatically align with the user’s implicit intentions when carrying out tasks on the user’s behalf, thereby enabling more personalized and cognitively faithful task execution.
blocks.zh:
我们把"Avatar Intelligence"概念化为一个以用户为中心的操作系统,将用户的认知外部化为持久且可执行的数字形式(图2 ). 这种系统的内核并不是一薄的内存缓存,而是用户认知身份的忠实而不断更新的模型.
更具体地说,在OS层面,Avatar不断观察用户的行为模式和决策逻辑,含蓄地建模并迭代地完善其对用户特征和行为模式的理解. 基于这种不断发展的用户模式,它可以在代表用户执行任务时自动与用户所隐含的意图保持一致,从而能够更个性化地,更忠实地执行认知任务.

blocks.en: Existing personalization methods largely optimize behavioral outputs using both training-time methods [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] and decoding-time alignment [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] , while current memory systems mainly extend context and accumulate experience [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 现有的个性化方法主要通过训练-时间方法[6,7,8,9,10]和解码-时间对接[11,12,13]来优化行为输出,而目前的内存系统主要扩展上下文并积累经验[14,15,16].

blocks.en: However, current methods are still insufficient for an Avatar that must preserve identity across contexts and over time. Operationally, the Avatar is organized around four tightly coupled components: perception , planning , decision , and execution , grounded by a persistent memory substrate. Together, they form a closed loop that transforms environmental signals into user-aligned action, enabling cognition to operate beyond explicit interaction.
blocks.zh: 然而,目前的方法对于必须保持不同背景和不同时期特性的 " 神通 " 来说仍然不足。 在实际操作中,神通组织围绕四个紧密结合的组成部分:感知、规划、决定和执行,其基础是持续的内存基底。 它们共同形成一个闭合环路,将环境信号转化为用户相通的行动,使得认知的操作超越了明确的相互作用.

blocks.en: In practical deployment, the Avatar instantiates multiple task-specialized clones as contextual projections of a single underlying identity, including work, assistant, social, and custom clones. These clones inherit the same user model while interfacing with heterogeneous execution substrates such as tools, applications, sandboxed environments, and external agents. This clone layer gives the Avatar three system-level capabilities essential to Avatar Intelligence:

blocks.en: allows task state to persist across time, applications, and contexts, making long-horizon execution possible without repeated user specification.
blocks.zh: 允许任务状态在时间,应用程序和上下文中持续,使得无需重复用户规格即可进行长视距执行.

blocks.en: allows clones to dynamically incorporate new tools, services, and agents, turning the Avatar into an open-ended system whose functional boundary evolves with the user’s needs.
blocks.zh: 允许克隆人动态地融入了新的工具,服务和代理,将"神通"变成一个无限制的系统,其功能界限会随着用户的需求而演变.

blocks.en: As these clones persist and scale, they will increasingly interface with other users’ agents, leading to a multi-avatar ecosystem in which many routine digital interactions are mediated by delegated representatives rather than direct human operation. In such settings, the core unit of interaction shifts from human–system to avatar–avatar coordination: scheduling, negotiation, information exchange, and joint task execution can occur through policies that represent distinct users’ identities and constraints. This shift reframes the technical problem from single-agent task completion to the design of protocols, incentives, and safety boundaries that enable cooperation under conflict, accountability under delegation, and trust under partial autonomy.
blocks.zh: 随着这些克隆的持续存在和规模扩大,它们将越来越多地与其他用户的代理人进行接触,从而形成一个多功能生态系统,许多日常数字互动由委派代表进行调解,而不是直接进行人类操作。 在这样的环境下,互动的核心单元从人类系统转变为模拟-avatar协调:时间安排、谈判、信息交流和联合任务执行可以通过代表不同用户身份和限制的政策来实现。 这一转变重新界定了技术问题,从单一代理任务完成到设计协议、奖励和安全界限,使冲突下的合作、授权下的问责制和部分自主下的信任成为可能。

blocks.en: 2.2  Roadmap
blocks.zh: 2.2 路线图

blocks.en: We view the path from today's agents to full Avatar Intelligence as a staged decoupling of human involvement from agentic capability (Figure 3 ). The stages differ not only in autonomy, but also in the required system guarantees (identity continuity, controllability, and accountability): • L0: Human-for-the-loop. The agent behaves as an augmented application, automating fragmented subprocesses while the user remains embedded in both execution and decisions. • L1: Human-in-the-loop. The agent executes longer workflows, but users still steer key decisions (goal refinement, routing, validation) and absorb most accountability. • L2: Human-on-the-loop. An avatar core (persistent identity + memory + decision policy) takes over routine decisions and orchestration; humans intervene at a small number of calibrated checkpoints, with robust runtime guardrails and audit trails. • L3: Human-out-of-the-loop. The avatar assumes end-to-end autonomy over both operations and decisions for delegated domains; humans primarily perform post-hoc auditing, dispute resolution, and policy updates.

blocks.en: 2.3  Agentic Oversight Index (AOI)

blocks.en: To evaluate progress toward Avatar Intelligence, we argue that capability improvements should be assessed jointly with the oversight burden they impose on users. blocks.en: 3  Applications
blocks.zh: 3 应用程序

blocks.en: 3.1  Current Industry Products
blocks.zh: 3.1 当前工业产品

blocks.en: A new generation of personal agents is beginning to turn persistent assistance into sustained action. Grok Bot keeps named bots and their context across tasks, allowing them to work through applications and return to the user when approval is needed [ 17 ] . Muse pursues ongoing goals through connected applications and a persistent browser, while seeking permission for actions such as sending messages or making purchases [ 18 ] . Cue envisions agents with their own email, phone, computer, and wallet, subject to boundaries set by the user [ 19 ] . OpenAI’s dots likewise continue work between conversations, draw on connected applications and memory, and bring decisions requiring human judgment back to the user [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 新一代的个人代理人开始将持续的援助转变为持续的行动。 格鲁克 Bot将命名为bots及其上下文贯穿任务,允许它们通过应用程序工作,并在需要批准时返回用户[17]. Muse通过连接的应用程序和持续浏览器追求持续的目标,同时为发送消息或进行购买等行动寻求许可[18]. Cue设想代理商使用自己的电子邮件,电话,计算机和钱包,但须遵守用户设定的边界[19]. OpenAI的点同样在对话间继续工作,

blocks.en: These systems move beyond one-off responses by carrying work forward over time. Yet the user remains central to setting goals, defining authority, and deciding when consequential actions may proceed. In the roadmap of Avatar Intelligence, they mark a transition from human-in-the-loop execution toward human-on-the-loop oversight within delegated tasks.
blocks.zh: 这些系统超越一次性反应,逐步推进工作。 然而,用户在确定目标、确定权威和决定何时可采取相应行动方面仍然至关重要。 在Avatar Intelligence的行进图中,它们标志着在授权任务范围内从人行即决向人行即决监督的过渡。

blocks.en: 3.2  Application Scenarios
blocks.zh: 3.2 应用设想

blocks.en: Figure 4: Four application settings for Avatar Intelligence. (1) personal life, (2) organizational work, (3) financial decisions, and (4) coordination among multiple avatars.
blocks.zh: 图 4: Avatar Intelligence的四个应用程序设置. (1)个人生活,(2)组织工作,(3)财务决策,(4)多方相声协调.

blocks.en: A personal avatar must carry commitments forward even when they are no longer visible in the immediate request. When a work trip conflicts with a parent–teacher meeting the user promised to attend weeks earlier, the avatar might first look for a later departure rather than simply clearing the calendar. If neither obligation can move, it should bring the conflict back to the user. The value of continuity lies in protecting obligations that a task-by-task assistant would easily overlook.
blocks.zh: 个人的先行者必须履行承诺,即使承诺在即时请求中不再明显。 当工作旅行与家长-教师会面时, 如果两项义务都无法转移,则应将冲突带回用户。 连续性的价值在于保护任务助理容易忽略的义务。

blocks.en: Suppose engineering flags a release-blocking defect, while the launch calendar and sales brief still promise a release today. Acting for the project manager, an avatar could decide to postpone the internal launch, update the shared schedule, and notify the teams relying on the old date. It cannot waive the engineering blocker or revise a customer commitment on the sales team’s behalf; those decisions must return to the people who hold that authority. Such coordination depends on a shared view of the project that changes with new evidence, and on the distinct authority of the roles involved [ 21 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 假设工程旗下有一个阻断故障 而发射日历和销售简报 仍然承诺今天发布。 出任项目经理的阿凡达可以决定推迟内部发射,更新共享时间表,并通知依靠旧日期的队伍. 它不能放弃工程阻断器或代表销售小组修改客户承诺;这些决定必须归还拥有这一权力的人。 这种协调取决于对项目的共同看法,这种看法随着新的证据而改变,并取决于所涉作用的独特权威[21、22]。

blocks.en: The same market move can call for different actions depending on whose money is at stake. A planned purchase that remains acceptable for one user may push another user’s portfolio beyond a chosen exposure limit. In the latter case, the avatar should pause the order and seek a decision, even if the original instruction was to buy. Financial delegation is credible only when the user’s risk preferences shape the action itself and changes to those preferences remain under the user’s control.
blocks.zh: 同样的市场移动可能要求采取不同的行动,这取决于涉及谁的钱。 一个用户仍可接受的计划采购可能会将另一个用户的投资组合推出选定的曝光限度。 在后一种情况下,即使原始指令是购买,活字号也应暂停订单并寻求决定. 只有在用户的风险偏好决定了行动本身,且这些偏好的变化仍在用户的控制之下时,财务授权才可信。

blocks.en: Once avatars act for different people, a locally sensible decision may be unacceptable to the other party. In arranging a meeting, one avatar may seek the earliest slot while another protects its user’s preparation time. They can exchange acceptable windows and settle on a time that respects both constraints, or return to their users if no such time exists. The question is how agents can reach agreements without exposing more of either user’s preferences than the negotiation requires.
blocks.zh: 一旦异形者为不同的人行事,当地明智的决定就可能为另一方所不能接受。 在安排会议时,一个阿凡达可能寻求最早的时间档,而另一个保护用户的准备时间. 他们可以交换可接受的窗口,在尊重两种限制的情况下安顿下来,或者在没有这种时间的情况下返回用户。 问题是,代理人如何在不暴露用户偏好的情况下达成协议,而不是在谈判要求的情况下。

blocks.en: 4  Open Challenges
blocks.zh: 4 公开挑战

blocks.en:
Avatar Intelligence sits at the interface between the user side and the rapidly advancing frontier of agent technology.
On the one hand, an avatar must learn a user’s cognitive and decision patterns—capturing not only preferences, but also reasoning habits, methodologies, and value commitments. As a result, it can reliably understand the user and act as a faithful proxy.
On the other hand, it must continuously grow and evolve in real-world environments: connecting the user to appropriate agent capabilities, simulating the likely consequences of alternative actions, and selecting options that are best aligned with the user’s objectives, thereby building calibrated trust.
Finally, as agents become embedded in everyday life, a central question is how to ensure that such autonomy remains safe and controllable, preventing harm to the user and their environment while preserving the benefits of proactive, long-horizon assistance.
blocks.zh:
Avatar Intelligence坐落在用户方与迅速发展的代理技术前沿之间的界面.
一方面,一个虚构者必须学习用户的认知和决策模式——不仅抓住偏好,而且抓住推理习惯、方法和价值承诺。 因此,它可以可靠地理解用户,并起到忠实的代理作用.
另一方面,它必须在现实环境中不断发展和发展:将用户与适当的代理能力联系起来,模拟替代行动的可能后果,选择最符合用户目标的选择,从而建立校准的信任。
最后,随着代理人被嵌入日常生活,一个核心问题是如何确保这种自主性保持安全和可控,防止对使用者及其环境造成伤害,同时保留主动、长期援助的好处。

blocks.en: 4.1  Personalization: From Behavioral Alignment to Identity-Continuous Avatars
blocks.zh: 4.1 个性化: 从行为一致到身份-持续神通

blocks.en: Personalization is central to Avatar Intelligence: an avatar must make decisions as the user would , not merely respond in the user's preferred style. This requires learning from diverse, authorized signals (instructions, interaction traces, and environmental context) to infer stable decision structure, including values, trade-offs, and reasoning habits.
blocks.zh: 个性化是Avatar Intelligence的核心:一个造型者必须像用户那样做决定,而不仅仅是以用户所喜欢的风格来回应. 这就需要从各种经授权的信号(指示、相互作用痕迹和环境背景)中学习,以推断稳定的决策结构,包括价值、取舍和推理习惯。

blocks.en: Most existing approaches [ 23 , 24 ] , however, optimize behavioral outputs (what action to take in a particular moment) rather than the latent cognitive model that generates behavior across contexts and over time. In practice, such systems often rely on memory to store user-specific facts or preferences and retrieve them at inference time. While effective for conversational personalization, memory-heavy heuristics can be brittle for agentic tasks: coverage is incomplete, preferences are context-dependent, and user behavior may be internally inconsistent. A core open problem is therefore to model an identity-continuous user representation that generalizes across tasks while remaining stable yet updateable.
blocks.zh: 然而,大多数现有方法[23,24],优化了行为输出(在特定时刻要采取的行动),而不是潜在的认知模式,这种认知模式在上下文之间并随着时间的推移产生行为. 在实践中,这类系统往往依靠内存存储用户特有的事实或偏好,并在推断时间取回. 虽然对对话的个性化有效,但内存-重度高压对代理任务来说可能很脆弱:覆盖不完整,偏好依赖上下文,用户行为可能内部不一致. 因此,一个核心的开放问题是树立一种身份连续的用户代表模式,将各种任务概括起来,同时保持稳定但可更新。

blocks.en: Complementary to learning-based personalization, many deployed systems also use explicit configuration of identity (values and constraints), memory policies, and skill/tool scopes. A typical example is OpenClaw. 3 3 3 https://openclaw.ai/ . The challenge is to unify these layers into a coherent user model that remains consistent across clones, environments, and time.
blocks.zh: 除了基于学习的个性化之外,许多部署的系统还使用身份(价值和限制)、记忆政策和技能/工具范围的明确配置。 OpenClaw就是典型的例子。 挑战在于将这些层统一成一个一致的用户模式,在克隆人、环境和时间之间保持一致。

blocks.en: We argue that Avatar Personalization should be formalized as learning an identity-continuous user model that enables transfer and generalization across tasks, while remaining stable yet evolvable.
blocks.zh: 我们主张, " 神通 " 个人化应正式化,作为学习一种身份连续的用户模式,这种模式能够使各种任务的转移和通用得以实现,同时保持稳定,但可演变。

blocks.en: A central requirement for Avatar Intelligence is that the user's cognition becomes computable and predictable to the system. Concretely, we characterize Avatar Personalization with two properties: • Thought Computability. The user's internal decision process admits a compact representation, enabling the avatar to simulate how the user would reason under diverse contexts. • Intent Predictability. Given a context, the avatar can reliably anticipate the user's intended action without requiring explicit instruction at every step. Together, these properties shift personalization from surface-level preference matching to learning an identity-continuous model that (i) generalizes across tasks, (ii) remains consistent across contexts, and (iii) evolves over time without drifting away from the user's values and decision structure. We provide a more detailed formalization—including a problem setting, an identity representation, and consistency/stability constraints—in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: Avatar Intelligence的一个中心要求是用户的认知能力成为系统可以计算和可预测的. 具体来说,我们把"神通"个人化定性为两个属性: 思想可计算性. 用户的内部决策程序承认一个紧凑的表示方式,使外观人能够模拟用户在不同背景下如何推理. • 意图可预测性。 从上下文来看,Avatar可以可靠地预测用户的预期行动,而不要求每个步骤都明确指示. 这些属性共同将个性化从表层偏好相匹配转向学习身份相续模式,该模式(一) 概括跨任务,(二) 保持不同背景的一致性,(三) 随时间演变而不会偏离用户的价值观和决策结构. 在附录A中,我们提供了更详细的形式,包括问题设置、身份代表以及一致性/稳定性限制。

blocks.zh: 思想计算. 用户的内部决策程序承认一个紧凑的表示方式,使外观人能够模拟用户在不同背景下如何推理.

blocks.en: Intent Predictability. Given a context, the avatar can reliably anticipate the user's intended action without requiring explicit instruction at every step.

blocks.en: 4.2  Evolving with Specialization
blocks.zh: 4.2 专业化的发展

blocks.en: The engineering of autonomous agents has historically focused on improving intent understanding and task completion through external scaffolding. From this perspective, prompt engineering injects user intent and constraints into the instruction channel; context engineering injects situational state (documents, observations, and memory) to ground planning; and harness engineering injects executable rules and control policies (e.g., tool gating, verification, retries, and escalation) to stabilize the action loop. These paradigms primarily shape behavior at inference time by conditioning what the agent sees and what it is allowed to do.
blocks.zh: 自主代理的工程在历史上一直注重通过外出脚手架提高意向理解并完成任务. 从这个角度出发,即时工程将用户的意向和约束注入了指令通道;上下文工程将情况状态(文件,观察和内存)注入了地面规划;并使用工程注入了可执行的规则和控制政策(例如工具地标,验证,重试和升级)来稳定动作回路. 这些范式主要通过对代理人所见所为和被允许的行为进行条件化,在推论时间塑造行为.

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison of four complementary agent engineering paradigms by signal, timing, mechanism, objective, and risk. Prompt engineering specifies intent and constraints; context engineering supplies task-relevant state; harness engineering governs execution; and Rehearsal Engineering uses staged scenarios and user-situated feedback to improve behavior across episodes. Rehearsal provides an adaptation process that draws on, and updates, the other three forms of engineering.
blocks.zh: 表1:按信号、时间、机制、目标和风险比较四个辅助剂工程范式。 即时工程规定了意向和制约因素;上下文工程提供了与任务相关的状态;利用工程管理执行;再排练工程使用已预设的场景和用户定位的反馈,以改善各事件的行为. 排练提供了一个借鉴并更新其他三种工程形式的适应过程.

blocks.en: A growing challenge, however, is to make agents evolve proactively from interaction with the environment. Recent explorations either (i) construct simulators or games where agents can rehearse trajectories, compare alternatives, and improve through iterative critique [ 25 ] , or (ii) expose agents to real environments or sandbox [ 26 , 27 , 28 ] where they observe state transitions, discover recurring patterns, and learn from sparse but high-fidelity outcomes. Despite their differences, both lines of work are fundamentally about acquiring effective feedback —signals that evaluate decisions, not just executions—and turning such feedback into better future policies.
blocks.zh: 然而,一项日益严峻的挑战是如何使行动者从与环境的互动中积极主动地演变。 最近的探索或者(一)构建模拟器或游戏,使代理商可以排练出轨迹,比较替代品,并通过迭代批判来改进[25],或者(二)将代理商暴露在真实环境或沙盒中[26,27,28],他们在其中观测到状态过渡,发现反复出现的模式,并学习稀有但高度真实的结果. 尽管存在分歧,但两条工作线基本上都是为了获得有效的反馈——评价决定的信号,而不仅仅是处决——并将这种反馈转化为更好的未来政策。

blocks.en:
For Avatar Intelligence, feedback cannot remain purely generic. Beyond learning in standardized benchmarks or public web contexts, an avatar must specialize within the user's own ecology: their tools, routines, constraints, and risk tolerances.
We refer to this user-situated specialization loop as Rehearsal Engineering : a system-level methodology for aligning a standardized, language-trained agent to the user's real environment by (1) collecting user- and environment-specific traces and preferences, (2) staging representative scenarios (via simulation, counterfactual rollouts, or controlled sandboxing), (3) evaluating candidate actions with explicit oversight policies, and (4) updating the avatar's memory, skill selection, and decision policy under bounded autonomy.
blocks.zh:
对"神通情报"来说,反馈不能纯粹是笼统的. 除了在标准化基准或公共网络背景下学习之外,一个形象还必须在用户自己的生态范围内:工具、例行公事、约束和风险容忍度方面有所专长。
我们把这种用户定位的专业化循环称为“排练工程”:(1) 收集用户和环境特有的痕迹和偏好,(2) 提出具有代表性的情景(通过模拟、反事实推出或控制沙箱),(3) 以明确的监督政策评价候选人行动,(4) 更新阿凡达的内存、技能选择和政策,从而将标准化的、语言训练的代理人与用户的真实环境相结合。

blocks.en:
Situated cognition research in psychology suggests that knowledge is closely tied to the contexts in which it is used [ 29 ] . By rehearsing within the user’s own work and life contexts, an agent may learn which contextual cues shape the user’s choices, and how those cues change the user’s trade-offs across situations.
In this view, rehearsal is not merely practice; it is the mechanism by which an avatar internalizes user-specific feedback while remaining safe, auditable, and corrigible.

分布在心理学中的认知研究显示,知识与使用知识的背景密切相关[29]. 通过在用户自己的工作和生活背景中进行排练,代理人可以了解哪些背景提示决定用户的选择,以及这些提示如何改变用户在各种情况下的取舍。
在这种观点中,排练不仅仅是实践,而是一个虚构者在保持安全、可审计和可腐蚀性的同时将用户特定反馈内部化的机制。

blocks.en: 4.3  Safety
blocks.zh: 4.3 安全问题

blocks.en: Safety is a prerequisite for Avatar Intelligence because avatars are persistent, stateful, and increasingly entrusted with system access and delegated decision authority. We view avatar safety as two complementary layers distinguished by function rather than agent capability. Technical safety continuously enforces delegated authority, reduces the likelihood of failures, and limits their consequences. Agent Insurance complements these controls by allocating residual financial risk and compensating covered losses under explicit contractual terms. Both layers support delegation across capability levels: greater capability does not remove the need for technical control, and insurance provides defined financial recourse rather than a guarantee of correct or user-aligned execution.
blocks.zh: 安全是Avatar情报的一个先决条件,因为Avatar人坚持不懈,状态良好,越来越多地被赋予系统访问权和授权决策权. 我们认为阿凡达安全是按功能而不是代理能力区分的两个互补层面。 技术安全持续执行授权,减少失败的可能性并限制其后果。 代理保险通过分配剩余财务风险和根据明确的合同条款赔偿所包括的损失来补充这些控制。 两层都支持跨能力一级的授权:更大的能力并不能消除技术控制的必要性,保险提供明确的财务追索权,而不是保证正确或用户一致的执行。

blocks.en: Across capability levels and throughout deployment, safety should be engineered end-to-end around intent fidelity, bounded autonomy, and adversarial robustness: • Intent alignment and corrigibility. Maintain synchronization between the avatar's policy and the user's intent through explicit preference/constraint representations, intent-drift detection, and structured escalation (ask/confirm) at high stakes. • Runtime governance (harness-level control). Enforce least privilege, sandboxing, action preconditions, irreversible-action verification, checkpointing/rollback, and deterministic replanning to constrain the action loop even when the model is wrong. • Security and integrity hardening. Continuously monitor tool usage and environment interactions; detect prompt injection and anomalous behaviors; and protect long-term memory, credentials, and dependencies via sanitization and supply-chain scanning.
blocks.zh: 在整个能力级别和部署期间,安全应围绕故意忠诚、有限度的自主权和对抗力来设计: 通过明确的偏好/约束表示、意图驱动检测和在高度利害关系下进行结构化升级(任务/确认),保持Avatar政策与用户意图之间的同步。 • 运行时间治理(疾病控制)。 执行最少的特权、沙盒、行动先决条件、不可逆转的行动核查、检查/回滚,以及确定性的重新规划,以限制行动循环,即使模式是错误的。 • 使安全和诚信更加稳固。 持续监测工具使用和环境互动;检测出即时注射和异常行为;通过消毒和供应链扫描保护长期内存、资质和依赖性。

blocks.en: Delegated tasks such as fund-moving, code changes, and account operations can expose users to substantial losses when execution fails. Technical safeguards reduce these risks, but residual uncertainty remains in open-world environments. Inspired by recent work on financial risk management for AI agents [ 30 ] , we argue that Agent Insurance , supported by auditable settlement mechanisms, will become a core infrastructure component for delegation at scale. Service fees can be escrowed and released upon verified delivery; providers can post collateral; and users can optionally purchase underwriting for losses arising from specified failures, such as non-delivery, misexecution, or intent misalignment. Coverage must define verifiable failure conditions, compensation limits, exclusions, and claims procedures. Crucially, compensation requires auditable evidence , including execution traces and evaluation artifacts, together with dispute processes. These mechanisms make responsibility for covered losses explicit and provide contractual recourse, while technical controls remain necessary to prevent harm, including harms that financial compensation cannot reverse.

blocks.en: Taken together, the open problems in personalization, rehearsal-driven specialization, and safety/assurance constitute the missing infrastructure for advancing from L2 (checkpointed delegation) to L3 (full-pipeline autonomy within delegated domains). Identity-continuous personalization provides a stable decision prior, while Rehearsal Engineering supplies user-situated feedback loops to adapt that prior to real environments. Technical safety continuously constrains delegated actions and limits failure propagation. Agent Insurance provides infrastructure for pricing and allocating residual financial risk and compensating contractually covered losses. Together, continuous technical control and defined financial recourse support trustworthy delegation at scale as avatars assume broader responsibilities with less routine human supervision.
blocks.zh: 个人化、排练驱动的专门化以及安全/保障方面的公开问题共同构成了从L2(被指定代表团)推进到L3(在授权领域实现完全管道自治)的缺失基础设施。 身份连续的个性化在之前提供了稳定的决定,而Rehearsal Engineering则提供用户位置的反馈回路来适应真实环境之前的回路. 技术安全不断限制授权的行动并限制故障传播。 代理保险为定价和分配剩余财务风险以及赔偿合同涵盖的损失提供基础设施。 持续的技术控制和明确的财务追索支助在规模上是值得信赖的,因为先行者承担了更广泛的责任,而人类的监督则较少。

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Avatar Intelligence frames persistent personal agents around a continuing relationship of decision delegation. Its value lies in enabling users to pursue their goals across tasks and over time with less routine supervision and effective control over consequential choices. We outlined a user-centric architecture, a delegation roadmap, and the Agentic Oversight Index to connect this objective with system design and evaluation. The central research agenda is to learn user representations that transfer across contexts, improve decisions through user-situated rehearsal, and support delegation with technical control, accountability, and recourse. Progress should be demonstrated through the decisions users can reliably delegate and the effort required to obtain outcomes they endorse.
blocks.zh: " 神通"情报部门将持续的个人特工 置于决策授权的持续关系之下 其价值在于使用户能够在任务之间和一段时间内追求目标,同时减少对相应选择的例行监督和有效控制。 我们概述了以用户为中心的结构、代表团路线图和代理监督指数,以便将这一目标同系统设计和评价联系起来。 中心研究议程是学习用户的表达方式,这些表达方式跨越不同背景,通过用户情况排练改进决策,并支持下放技术控制、问责制和追索权。 应通过用户能够可靠地授权作出决定和为取得他们认可的结果而需要作出的努力来证明取得的进展。
